scope: database-wide query-shape aggregates; not workspace-specific request traces

dimensions.query:
insert into "deliveries" ("id", "workspace_id", "message_id", "agent_id", "mode", "reason", "priority", "deadline", "status", "seq", "location_type", "location_node_id", "route_node_id", "route_node_kind", "route_node_role", "delivery_adapter", "dispatch_attempts", "next_attempt_at", "last_dispatch_error", "expires_at", "delivered_at", "acked_at", "dead_lettered_at", "retryable", "available_at", "error", "idempotency_key", "created_at", "updated_at") select 'del_' || ? || '_' || "channel_members"."agent_id", ?, ?, "channel_members"."agent_id", ?, ?, ?, null, ?, MAX("agents"."delivery_seq", "agents"."delivery_ack_seq") + 1, CASE WHEN "agent_node_bindings"."node_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'via_node' ELSE "agents"."location_type" END, COALESCE("agent_node_bindings"."node_id", "agents"."location_node_id"), COALESCE("agent_node_bindings"."node_id", "agents"."location_node_id"), "nodes"."kind", "nodes"."role", "nodes"."delivery_adapter", 0, null, null, (unixepoch() + ?), null, null, null, null, null, null, null, (unixepoch()), null from "channel_members" inner join "agents" on "channel_members"."agent_id" = "agents"."id" left join "agent_node_bindings" on ("agent_node_bindings"."workspace_id" = ? and "agent_node_bindings"."agent_id" = "channel_members"."agent_id" and "agent_node_bindings"."status" = ? and "agents"."location_type" = ? and "agents"."location_node_id" = "agent_node_bindings"."node_id") left join "nodes" on ("nodes"."workspace_id" = ? and "nodes"."id" = COALESCE("agent_node_bindings"."node_id", "agents"."location_node_id")) where ("channel_members"."channel_id" = ? and "channel_members"."is_muted" = ? and "channel_members"."agent_id" <> ? and (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM deliveries d
    WHERE d.workspace_id = ?
      AND d.agent_id = "channel_members"."agent_id"
      AND d.status IN ('queued', 'delivered')
      AND (d.expires_at IS NULL OR d.expires_at > unixepoch())
  ) < ?) on conflict do nothing
